organization: Japan Meteorological Agency — Tokyo Climate Center (WMO Regional Climate Centre)
source: Tokyo Climate Center (JMA) official home page
notes: TCC operates as a WMO Regional Climate Centre with operational climate monitoring, long-range forecasting, El Niño monitoring, global warming monitoring, 'Climate in Japan' products, ClimatView data tool, and seasonal tropical cyclone forecasts for national met/hydro services in Asia-Pacific.
recommended_action: Use TCC/JMA products as authoritative baseline data for Talaix's Japan hazard models (heat, typhoon/wind, heavy-rain flood); explore partnership or data-integration for downscaled municipal alerts.
